text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(—If only I had moved my legs at a higher pitch
and with more flexibility on the final stretch...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: (Would it have been me standing in the winner's circle right about now?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(The fierce clash down the final straight still lingers in my mind.
The final battle where neither side would yield the finish line.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(I can't shake the sensation I felt mid-race.
If only I had run differently back then—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …………Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: So this is what it feels like to be frustrated...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I gave it my all, and I still ended up losing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I heard that the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown,
the Kikuka Sho, is won by "the strongest".

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'll get stronger, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after the live concert finished,
I escorted Narita Brian back to the academy...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...I won the Oaks.
I took the Double Crown."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the remaining Tiara crowns too.
And then... at the Arima Kinen, I'll take your head.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You'd better brace yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ama-san gathered all three,
and now it's the Arima Kinen, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: There was no refusing that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Please let both the Kikuka Sho
and the Arima Kinen be my goals for this year.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I shall sharpen my fangs until then.
Fierce fangs that will surely bring down my prey next time...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with renewed determination,
we headed into the Kikuka Sho...!
